serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Wait a minute. Why is Annalie here?
Bot: Turns out she was a citizen here all along!
You: What?! Do you mean that we didn’t need to come here with the Landlord?! 
Bot: Seems like it!
You: All that hard work…
Lady Annalie: Hey! Come and help me with my sand castle! It needs more towers!
You: Maybe later!
